payload.title: Implement four focused privacy and recorder-reliability improvements
acceptance: Validated per-project automatic-capture/minimization controls preserve explicit intent and expose deliberate disablement.
Structural redaction and deterministic fixtures protect recognized secrets across automatic/explicit intent and diagnostic storage without claiming universal PII detection.
Bounded local recorder supervision restarts crashed children, preserves queue and fencing, and respects stop/uninstall with single-instance tests.
Doctor separates present health from historical failures and reports bounded observation gaps without reconstructing missing events.
